prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 5 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the top-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a world-map icon of an ancient ruined temple of evil seen from above at a three-quarter angle, as wide as it is tall and filling the whole square box edge to edge: a broad, low, stepped dark grey-blue stone temple on a cracked stone platform that spans the full width of the box. The building is ASYMMETRIC: on the LEFT side a squat stepped tower with a crumbling peaked roof and a short dark spire; the RIGHT side is a low pillared porch with a huge entrance. The entrance is NOT in the middle: a very wide, tall black arched doorway with a faint purple glow at the bottom edge, its left side at about 60 % and its right side at about 90 % of the box width (centred three quarters of the way from the left side, a third of the box wide), with a broken column on each side of it and a small brazier with a purple flame left of it. A little green moss and ivy; nothing outside the platform.
- the top-centre box (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). the gap in a collapsed wooden bridge seen from straight above, on a plain magenta background: along the top edge and along the bottom edge, the snapped ends of plain mid-brown wooden deck planks (laid top to bottom; the same light mid-brown as a simple wooden bridge deck, about RGB 145, 106, 68, with thin dark brown gaps) stick out with jagged splintered tips and one plank hanging loose; four broken wooden piling stumps stand in the gap; a few loose planks and a coil of rope float in the middle; the middle of the box is empty: do NOT draw any water, sea or frame anywhere; leave flat magenta (#FF00FF) between all the pieces (the game draws its own sea under them).

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
